reference_protocol.selection: Existing v5 prior-only rolling selection/calibration, unchanged promotion guards.
reference_protocol.policy: No tuning on outer target outcomes. Each candidate evaluated on identical available pairs within a horizon; unknown targets excluded, not zero-filled.
reference_protocol.previous_exposure: Source was inspected and evaluated with a legacy 28-day pipeline previously; this is a new fixed-protocol re-evaluation, not a pristine independent dataset.

protocol.global_xgb: Same v5 pooled Poisson training rows/features/hyperparameters, except ordinal product index replaced with one-hot product indicators.
protocol.selector: Prior-only batch MAE across existing statistical and new intermittent/top-down methods, reserved calibration separation as in v5; XGBoost evaluated independently.
protocol.gate: Research only. Compare with v5 AND the best fixed existing statistical candidate, check folds/horizons/products/bias; known public outcomes require independent confirmation before production promotion.
protocol.data_policy: Unchanged observed/inferred-zero actuals; missing records remain unknown. No new dataset, no DB/production writes.

audit.zero_status: No source closure/availability evidence. Product zeroes are inferred recorded-sales zeroes on active dates, not verified zero demand.
audit.unknown_policy: Omit missing periods from intermittent state updates and score masks. Never impute zeros.

selection_note: Per-origin choices retained; verbose inner validation scores remain in the local results.json, reproducible with investigate_sparse.py.
